title: Month 7 Day 1
notes:
This teaching is a question-driven walk through the tribulation timeline, beginning with how the plague events and seven trumpets line up with the Feast of Trumpets and the seven-year period. It examines Revelation 17’s ten horns as ten kings and ten Caesars, then follows what happens after Titus—the sheep and goat judgment, the state of the dead, the lake of fire, and why eternal torment has been taught. The study also takes up Enoch, the watchers, Vesuvius, and the release of the 200, before closing with the central questions of where we stand on the timeline and whether we can know when Yeshua is returning.
